info.title: Katge optional search and asset extraction API
info.description: Generated from the runtime Zod contracts. This reference covers the optional search surface, shared job operations and clip creation. Other legacy REST routes and MCP transport are outside this document. KATGE_SEARCH_ENABLED defaults to 0; this file does not assert a live deployment. Tenant identity comes from authentication. Source registration is restricted to the exact operator-owned MP4 catalogue. Results are unverified candidates; speech is literal text search. first/all occurrence proof and temporal/action verification are unavailable.

get.description: Search results additionally require search:read. Clip results additionally require clips:read. Pending results return 409 with Retry-After: 2. Poll jobs at least two seconds apart. Expired or foreign jobs are hidden.

MultimodalSearchInput.description: AND combines overlapping candidate intervals, optionally within temporal_tolerance_ms. OR unions candidates and requires temporal_tolerance_ms=0. Supply idempotency_key in the body or Idempotency-Key header.
